description: This file defines classes, enums, macros, and data structures related to CJ125 sensor logic and control, including hardware communication interfaces, sensor states, error codes, modes, and heater parameters within the firmware.

classes.name: Cj125SpiStream
classes.description: Abstract class representing SPI communication interface with CJ125 sensor hardware.

classes.name: CJ125
classes.description: Main class encapsulating the CJ125 sensor logic, including heater control, mode setting, error handling, and communication via SPI.

methods.name: ReadRegister
methods.description: Reads a byte from a specified register over SPI.

methods.name: WriteRegister
methods.description: Writes a byte to a specified register over SPI.

methods.name: isWorkingState
methods.description: Checks if the sensor is in a state suitable for operation.

methods.name: SetIdleHeater
methods.description: Configures heater parameters for idle state.

methods.name: StartHeaterControl
methods.description: Initiates heater control with a given callback.

methods.name: cjIdentify
methods.description: Performs identification of the sensor hardware.

methods.name: cjSetMode
methods.description: Sets the operational mode of the sensor.

methods.name: isValidState
methods.description: Verifies if the sensor is in a valid state.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets the error code for the sensor.
